tool: macOS sample, 1 second at 1 ms intervals
interpretation: The stripped executable retains callsite offsets rather than full Zig symbols. The decoder worker spends a substantial share of samples in memmove. A move-to-front vector-copy prototype was tested and rejected; paired high-entropy/repetitive results are retained in next-review-macos-rejected-mtf.json. The retained bounded Huffman lookup is checked separately against canonical codes, malformed inputs, and round trips. Unknown callsite offsets are not attributed to specific functions.
limits: One short sample on one host, with other host workloads; not a portable CPU attribution or throughput guarantee.
